rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Relative Path Traversal
rules.description: Accessing paths influenced by users can allow an attacker to access unexpected resources.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an secret, possibly allowing a timing attack to retrieve sensitive information.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
rules.description: Leaking information about an exception, such as messages and stack traces, to an external user can expose implementation details that are useful to an attacker for developing a subsequent exploit.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: A statement has no effect

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Document Type Definition
rules.description: Parsing user input as an XML document with external entity expansion is vulnerable to XXE attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Active Debug Code
rules.description: Running a Flask app in debug mode may allow an attacker to run arbitrary code through the Werkzeug debugger.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious tar archive without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can cause files outside the destination directory to be overwritten.
